request.style: English, male solo voice, warm and resonant, acoustic guitar, cello, piano, soft percussion, atmospheric pads, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
By the river I saw two men stand
One on this bank, one on the other side
One asked the man in linen
How long until the wonders end

[Chorus]
A time, times, and half a time
Till the holy people's power breaks
The words are closed and sealed
Until the time of the end

[Verse]
I heard but did not understand
My lord, what will be the outcome?
He said go your way, Daniel
The book is sealed until the end

[Chorus]
A time, times, and half a time
Till the holy people's power breaks
The words are closed and sealed
Until the time of the end

[Verse]
Many shall be purified and white
Refined by the fire of truth
The wicked shall act wickedly
None of them will understand

[Bridge]
From the daily sacrifice taken away
The abomination that causes desolation
One thousand two hundred and ninety days
Blessed is he who waits to the end

[Outro]
Go your way until the end
You will rest and rise to your lot
